# manta_cloudinit_defaults (Resource)

Set default meta-data for cluster in cloud-init.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_cloudinit_defaults" "defaults" {
  base_url    = var.cloud_init
  public_keys = var.public_keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) URL to cloud-init
- `public_keys` (List of String) Public keys add in `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`
